title: All Oone Data Structure
description: Design a data structure that tracks the count of strings and returns one with the min or max frequency in O(1).
pseudocode:
1. inc(key): update frequency map and move key in DLL of buckets
2. dec(key): update frequency map and move key or remove if count 0
3. getMax(): return tail.keys.any()
4. getMin(): return head.keys.any()

steps.note: Get max. Tail bucket is frequency 2, returning 'A'.
Get min. Head bucket is frequency 1, returning 'B'.
